title: 第15章 逐出军营第16章 驸马爷身份的好处
slug: 提前登陆游戏世界开局联姻女帝
content_zh:
这一幕发生的太快，所有人都没反应过来。
这真是说动手就动手啊！
这么百无禁忌吗？
直到众人看着赵宇无力下垂，嘴角有鲜血溢出，这才从呆滞状态中反应过来。
“旅帅！”
军帐中有人惊呼，连忙夺门而出，前去搀扶赵宇。
“没想到咱们这位校尉看着斯文，但却是个暴脾气！”
“不是说，咱们这位校尉是有名的废物吗，怎么实力如此之强，赵旅帅可是八品巅峰境界了！”
“有点霸道啊！”
……
军营中，有人站在远处，小声议论，神色吃惊。
有人注意到了夏辰的实力，竟然仅一刀而已，就击败了赵宇。
要知道赵宇出身侯府，修炼的不是普通功法，平日里可是能够和军中几位七品高手交上几招的。
虽然赵宇是仓促接招的，但这也败的太干净利落了。
先前带领夏辰进来的李喜眼中也带着吃惊，他预想到了会有冲突爆发，但却没想到会是地头蛇的赵宇一来就吃大亏。
他看向夏辰的目光开始有些变化，这位名动京城的侯府废体，看来是有一些真本事的。
不要说是他吃惊，就连夏辰身后的夏千几人眼神中都有波澜，夏千感觉，自家公子这段时间变化有些大，不仅心思不可琢磨，连实力好似也突飞猛进了。
夏辰一招打败赵宇之后，神色依旧不变，他缓缓将手中赤红长刀收回刀鞘中，然后挑起军帐门帘，阳光倾斜在夏辰的身上，让他整个人如同沐浴在黄金海洋中，神圣威严，不可侵犯。
“好一张俊俏的脸庞！”
这是所有看到夏辰面孔的人的第一反应，夏辰此时虽然穿着铠甲，没有做富贵公子哥打扮，但无论是外貌还是气质，都太为出挑了。

夏辰缓缓走到赵宇身边。
“你想对我家公子干什么？”
赵宇此时脸色苍白，神态萎靡，看到夏辰向他走来，想要抬起双臂，但双臂刚才被夏辰一刀给震断了，而他身后的三名士兵连忙站起，挡在赵宇身前。
这是赵府家兵！
“赵宇藐视上级，已被我拿下，甲子营何在？”
夏辰面对赵府家兵的质问并不答，而是环顾一周，那不大的声音却如涟漪一般扩散，在整个军营中响起。
四周士兵面面相觑，但很快，有人反应过来快速的在空地上集合。
原本有些犹豫的士卒，看到周围同伴前去集合又看了一眼，还躺在地上吐血的赵宇，咬了咬牙，也融进队伍中。
整个甲子营98号人仅仅十几个呼吸间而已，便整队成军。
“督纪队何在？”
夏辰话音落下，甲子营中，有五人动作干净利索的走了出来。
这位空降的校尉，连赵家都不放在眼里，侯府嫡子更是说打就打，现在威严正盛，他根本可不敢含糊。
“拖下去，100军棍，然后让晋武侯府来领人，即今日起，逐出禁军！”
夏辰看了一眼躺在地上的赵宇，又看了一眼督纪队的人，不带丝毫感情的声音在整个军营响起，让很多人都打了个寒颤。
“逐……逐出禁军？”
督纪队队长李正颤颤巍巍的问道。
“听不清吗？要我再阐述一遍！”
content_en:
This scene happened so fast that no one could react.
This really means taking action!
Is it so taboo?
It wasn't until everyone saw Zhao Yu drooping feebly, with blood spilling from the corners of his mouth, that they finally came to their senses from the sluggish state.
"Commander of the Brigade!"
Someone in the military tent exclaimed and rushed out of the door to help Zhao Yu.
"I didn't expect that our captain looks gentle, but he has a bad temper!"
"Didn't you say that our captain is a famous trash? Why is he so strong? Brigadier Zhao is at the peak of the eighth rank!"
"A bit overbearing!"
…
In the military camp, there were people standing in the distance, talking quietly, looking surprised.
Someone noticed Xia Chen's strength, and he defeated Zhao Yu with just one strike.
You must know that Zhao Yu was born in the Hou Mansion and practiced no ordinary skills. On weekdays, he could compete with several seventh-level masters in the army.
Although Zhao Yu accepted the move in a hurry, his defeat was too clean.
Li Xi, who had led Xia Chen in earlier, also had surprise in his eyes. He expected that a conflict would break out, but he did not expect that Zhao Yu, a local snake, would suffer a big loss as soon as he arrived.
The way he looked at Xia Chen began to change. The ruined body of the Hou Mansion, who was famous in the capital, seemed to have some real abilities.
Not to mention that he was surprised, even Xia Qian and the others behind Xia Chen had a look in their eyes. Xia Qian felt that his young master had changed a lot during this period. Not only was his mind unfathomable, but his strength also seemed to have improved by leaps and bounds.
After Xia Chen defeated Zhao Yu with one move, his expression remained unchanged. He slowly put the long red sword in his hand back into the scabbard, and then raised the curtain of the military tent. The sunlight slanted on Xia Chen's body, making him feel as if he was bathing in a sea of ​​gold. He was sacred, majestic and inviolable.
"What a handsome face!"
This was the first reaction of everyone who saw Xia Chen's face. Although Xia Chen was wearing armor and not dressing up as a wealthy young man, his appearance and temperament were too outstanding.
Xia Chen slowly walked to Zhao Yu.
"What do you want to do to my young master?"
Zhao Yu was pale and depressed at this time. When he saw Xia Chen walking towards him, he wanted to raise his arms, but his arms were broken by Xia Chen's knife just now. The three soldiers behind him quickly stood up and blocked Zhao Yu.
This is the Zhao family soldier!
"Zhao Yu defied his superiors and has been captured by me. Where is Jiazi Camp?"
Xia Chen did not answer the questions from the soldiers of the Zhao family. Instead, he looked around, and the small voice spread like ripples and resounded throughout the entire military camp.
The soldiers around looked at each other in confusion, but soon, some people reacted and quickly gathered in the open space.
The soldiers who were hesitant at first saw their companions going to gather and took another look. Zhao Yu, who was still lying on the ground vomiting blood, gritted his teeth and integrated into the team.
The entire Jiazi Camp No. 98 only took a dozen breaths to form an army.
"Where is the Discipline Inspection Team?"
After Xia Chen finished speaking, five people walked out of the Jiazi Camp with clean movements.
This airborne captain was not even looked down upon by the Zhao family, and the legitimate son of the Hou family was even more likely to hit him whenever he asked. Now that he was so majestic, he did not dare to be vague at all.
"Pull it down, 100 military sticks, and then let Jin Wuhou's Mansion come to pick them up. Starting today, we will drive out the forbidden army!"
Xia Chen glanced at Zhao Yu who was lying on the ground, and then at the people in the discipline inspection team. His emotionless voice sounded throughout the military camp, making many people shudder.
"Expulsion...expulsion of the Forbidden Army?"
Li Zheng, captain of the discipline inspection team, asked tremblingly.
"Can't you hear me clearly? You want me to explain it again!"
